data.title: Ghalia
data.about:
Certified Sharia compliant by the Sharia Committee of Dar Al Sharia, Ghalia offers a collection of furnished apartments with Arabian design cues. 

Elegantly-appointed rooms are thoughtfully furnished – lounges come with sofa beds and kitchens are fully equipped; while a host of luxurious amenities, such as the outdoor swimming pools and state-of-the-art gymnasiums – separate for men and women, showcase a commitment to quality, with a setup that adheres to Islamic principles. Ghalia also offers dedicated floors for women, and independent dining outlets for families and unaccompanied men. Ghalia is where you enjoy contemporary comfort while living in line with your beliefs.

characteristics_module.description:

  • Family Friendly Outdoor Spaces & Children’s Play Area
  • Prayer Rooms
  • Dedicated Floors for Women
  • Furnished Studios, 1 , 2 & 3 Apartments

location_tile.title: Close to Everything, Far from Everyday
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: Ghalia is perfectly located in Jumeirah Village Circle, a community that promises its residents a holistic living experience. Here, people enjoy a generous measure of peace, happiness and harmony.
